description: This file defines the EntityResolverManager class in Drupal, responsible for managing entity route parameter conversion, including reflection-based upcasting and route default handling.

classes.name: EntityResolverManager
classes.description: Manages entity route parameter conversion, including reflection-based upcasting and route default handling in Drupal.

methods.name: getControllerClass
methods.description: Determines the controller class or method from route defaults.

methods.name: setParametersFromReflection
methods.description: Uses reflection to set upcasting information for route parameters based on controller method signatures.

methods.name: setParametersFromEntityInformation
methods.description: Sets upcasting info based on '_entity_view' and '_entity_form' route defaults.

methods.name: setRouteOptions
methods.description: Main method to set route options, including reflection and entity default-based upcasting.

methods.name: getEntityTypes
methods.description: Retrieves all entity types managed by the entity type manager.
